capabilities: Render multi-series numerical logs as 3D time-series charts
Switch between 3D perspective and 2D top-down projections
Magnify compressed day segments on hover
Open source notes from 3D value pills
Sync chart palettes with Obsidian dark and light themes
extras: Renders in a WebGL2 viewport; includes a copy-paste DataviewJS playground for testing without external notes.
intentEvidence: Requires the Dataview plugin with Enable JavaScript Queries turned on.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to explore multi-series numerical logs as interactive 3D time-series visualizations.

relations.evidence: Requires the Dataview plugin with Enable JavaScript Queries turned on.

summary: WebGL2 engine that renders Dataview numerical logs as interactive 3D/2D time-series charts with theme-synced color palettes.
